scope.heritage_rule: The exact asset, bounded portfolio, legal person or right must be connected to FTI Touristik or Meeting Point by a cited public source. Group branding, geography, chronology or a similar hotel name alone is insufficient.
scope.purpose: Maintain a reviewable baseline and detect public-source changes concerning acquisition, ownership, sale, hotel operation, management, franchise, lease, lending, security, investment, refinancing, restructuring or another capital transaction involving the bounded former FTI Touristik / Meeting Point Spanish perimeter.
scope.coverage_status: BOUNDED_MONITOR_NOT_COMPREHENSIVE: three heritage scopes, twelve automated-safe public sources, eleven explicit official-source lanes and eight open gaps; unknown counterparties, new official-file identifiers and complete asset/register coverage require separate discovery and human reconciliation.
exclusions: Private transaction-development contacts, negotiations, NDAs, pricing, leverage, valuations and unannounced opportunities.
Automatic publication, automatic allegations, automatic identity resolution and automatic external notifications.
Hotels or companies linked only by brand resemblance, geography, chronology or unsupported recollection.
A claim that an acquisition transfers predecessor knowledge, intent, conduct, criminal responsibility or liability.

field_contract.entity: Record exact display name, legal-person or perimeter status, aliases, immutable CAEPR ID when eligible, identity boundary and next source when unresolved.
field_contract.asset: Record an exact asset or explicitly bounded portfolio, geography, precision state and the public-source bridge to the former FTI Touristik / Meeting Point perimeter.
field_contract.capacity: Record one controlled capacity per actor and the exact source that supports it; never derive owner, operator, manager, lender or beneficiary from another capacity.
field_contract.date: Record the date value, precision and what the date means; notification, authorisation, signing, closing, funding and operational handover remain separate.
field_contract.source: Record a stable source ID, public HTTPS URL, priority, publisher type, monitored scope and proposition boundary; store no native private material.
field_contract.evidence_state: Use a controlled evidence state that distinguishes official confirmation, party announcement, corroboration, single-source reporting, unreviewed change signal and identity uncertainty.
field_contract.change_detection: Hash only public-safe normalized content or binary bytes, compare with the previous metadata-only state, report controlled term IDs without page bodies, and require human review before any event or inference is promoted.

heritage_scopes.label: Meeting Point Spain and subsidiaries — fifteen Canary Islands hotel establishments
heritage_scopes.historic_fti_meeting_point_link: CNMC C/1549/25 identifies Meeting Point Spain and subsidiaries as the acquired target and records a fifteen-establishment Canary Islands management perimeter.
does_not_establish: The identity, title owner, operator, manager, lessor, lender or security holder for each of the fifteen establishments.
That the transaction was an asset sale rather than a control/share acquisition.
That every historic FTI/Meeting Point record or liability transferred.

heritage_scopes.label: Three Spanish Meeting Point debtors in proceeding 357/2024
heritage_scopes.historic_fti_meeting_point_link: Signed Auto 97/2025 identifies three Spanish Meeting Point legal persons in the joint pre-insolvency negotiation communication; their complete asset, management, contract and security schedules are not public.
does_not_establish: That all three were included in C/1549/25 or in any closing perimeter.
That any one was the Club Sei Lanzarote contracting entity.
Their current solvency, ownership, management, debt, security or asset position.

heritage_scopes.label: Club Sei Lanzarote / Sun Park–Lava Verde public-commercial project relationship
heritage_scopes.historic_fti_meeting_point_link: Public trade and project sources connect Club Sei Lanzarote to the Meeting Point / FTI commercial perimeter and the Sun Park–Lava Verde location.
does_not_establish: A completed acquisition, management contract, booking, revenue flow or asset ownership by a Meeting Point legal person.
The exact hotel inventory or authority of any party to commercialise individual units.
That the later fifteen-hotel transaction included Sun Park, Lava Verde or Club Sei Lanzarote.

sources.title: Portobello Capital public website
sources.source_boundary: Party website used for change discovery; no homepage wording is promoted without the specific dated publication and entity/asset reconciliation.

sources.title: BLUESEA Hotels public website
sources.source_boundary: Brand/operator website used for public portfolio-change discovery; a listing does not resolve hotel ownership, operator legal person or acquisition history.

sources.title: FTI / Meeting Point insolvency information portal
sources.source_boundary: Insolvency information portal; monitor notices and source-file changes without treating all group companies, assets, administrators or proceedings as interchangeable.

sources.title: MHBK FTI group procedure page
sources.source_boundary: Insolvency-practitioner procedure page; establishes its statements and linked notices, not asset inclusion or completed disposal without transaction-specific proof.

sources.title: MHBK current public media index
sources.source_boundary: Listing-page discovery only; a content change must be followed to the dated underlying publication before review.

sources.title: SEPI Meeting Point and BLUESEA FASEE authorisation release
sources.source_boundary: Official authorisation announcement; separate Meeting Point EUR 31 million and BLUESEA EUR 25 million operations must not be merged or treated as proof of drawdown, current balance or asset-level use.

sources.title: SEPI FASEE 2023 annual accounts
sources.source_boundary: Official accounts establish the disclosed instrument allocation and movements only; they do not trace funds into a hotel, establish current exposure or prove disclosure failures.

sources.title: German-Spanish Chamber report on the Meeting Point rescue transaction
sources.source_boundary: Independent trade/chamber context; reported timing and structure require confirmation against CNMC, signed instruments and party closing sources.

sources.title: Multilingual Google News RSS discovery — FTI / Meeting Point / Labranda / BLUESEA in Spain and Canary Islands
sources.source_boundary: Discovery feed only; titles, links and co-occurrence create review leads and never establish identity, capacity, transaction state or heritage inclusion.

official_source_lanes.label: BOE / BORME entity and transaction notices
official_source_lanes.boundary: BORME notices can identify published corporate acts but are not a complete current company, ownership, beneficial-owner, asset or transaction chain. Exact legal-person queries and document reconciliation remain manual.

official_source_lanes.label: Registro Público Concursal
official_source_lanes.boundary: A public notice or search result is not a complete docket, signed disposition, asset schedule, sale authorisation or proceeding ledger. Exact debtor and file queries require human reconciliation.

official_source_lanes.label: German Insolvenzbekanntmachungen
official_source_lanes.boundary: Official insolvency notices require exact debtor, court and file reconciliation and do not constitute a complete estate, disposition, sale or custody ledger. No CAPTCHA or session-control circumvention is permitted.

official_source_lanes.label: German Unternehmensregister
official_source_lanes.boundary: Public company-report discovery and document access require exact entity and reporting-period review; search results do not establish current ownership, asset inclusion, capacity or transaction participation.

official_source_lanes.label: German Handelsregister documents
official_source_lanes.boundary: Fee, session or document-access conditions must be respected. The monitor does not authenticate, pay, scrape sessions or infer ownership/control from an isolated extract.

official_source_lanes.label: CNMC new concentration-case discovery
official_source_lanes.boundary: The configured sources monitor only known file C/1549/25. They do not discover every new CNMC case, alias, vehicle or later concentration concerning the bounded perimeter.

official_source_lanes.label: CNMV public filings and issuer disclosures
official_source_lanes.boundary: Issuer, fund, manager and filing identifiers must be resolved before search; a CNMV publication does not by itself prove asset inclusion, beneficial ownership, use of funds or transaction completion.

official_source_lanes.label: Canary Islands tourism/operator registers and open data
official_source_lanes.boundary: Licence, establishment or open-data entries require hotel-by-hotel reconciliation. They do not automatically establish title owner, manager, lessee, franchisee, lender, transaction date or former-group heritage.

official_source_lanes.label: BDNS / SNPSAP public subsidy records
official_source_lanes.boundary: Award, call and beneficiary results require exact identifiers and do not prove payment, asset-level use, security, compliance, current exposure or transaction treatment.

official_source_lanes.label: Spanish public procurement and TED notices
official_source_lanes.boundary: PLACSP and TED notices are discovery lanes for public contracts, concessions or asset processes; they do not prove private hotel ownership, financing, closing or broader group participation.

official_source_lanes.label: Spanish property title, Catastro and security records
official_source_lanes.boundary: Catastro supplies descriptive/parcel data, not legal title. A nota simple is informative and certification is authoritative; fees, legitimate-interest and privacy limits apply. The monitor never bypasses those controls or treats one record as a complete asset/security chain.

asset.display_name: Meeting Point Spain, S.L.U. and subsidiaries / fifteen Canary Islands hotel-establishment management perimeter

entities_and_capacities.capacity_boundary: Acquired target identified by CNMC; this does not make MPS the title owner or operator of every establishment.
CNMC source literal identifies Portobello Capital, S.L. as acquirer through the BLUESEA vehicle; exact vehicle economics remain open.
Vehicle through which CNMC records the control acquisition; hotel-by-hotel owner/operator capacity is not established.

transaction_date.meaning: CNMC first-phase authorisation date, not signing, closing, funding or operational handover date.

proves: CNMC C/1549/25 recorded and authorised Portobello's acquisition, through Gestora Blue Sea Partner, of exclusive control over Meeting Point Spain and subsidiaries.
The public report describes a fifteen-establishment Canary Islands hotel-management perimeter.
does_not_prove: Closing, funding, consideration, debt structure or beneficial ownership after the authorisation date.
The exact fifteen hotels, title holders, operators, management companies, leases, lenders or security package.
That Club Sei Lanzarote or Sun Park–Lava Verde was included.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: Competition authorisation permits a concentration; it is not evidence of every contractual step or later performance.
An acquisition of corporate control is not an asset-by-asset conveyance and does not transfer predecessor liability automatically.

change_detection.next_review_trigger: Any public change mentioning MPS, Portobello, BLUESEA, Labranda or an identified hotel together with a controlled transaction/capacity term.

asset.display_name: Labranda / Meeting Point Hotels transaction — fifteen Canary Islands properties described at portfolio level

entities_and_capacities.capacity_boundary: Buyer-side public statement; exact purchasing vehicle, consideration and hotel-by-hotel capacity remain open.
BLUESEA vehicle/perimeter in the announced closing; no automatic owner or operator status for each hotel.
Commercial Meeting Point Hotels perimeter referenced by the announcement, not an exact seller legal person.

transaction_date.meaning: The announcement date establishes that the publisher described the transaction as recently closed by then; it is not the exact closing date.

proves: Portobello/BLUESEA publicly stated by 14 January 2026 that the Labranda / Meeting Point Hotels transaction had recently closed.
The same public statement described fifteen additional Canary Islands properties at portfolio level.
does_not_prove: The exact closing date, price, financing, sellers, legal vehicles or title transfer for every property.
The individual property list or hotel-by-hotel owner, operator, manager, lease, franchise, lender or security holder.
Receipt of every historic Club Sei, FTI, Meeting Point or Sun Park record.
contrary_or_limiting_evidence: This is a buyer-side announcement and remains distinct from the earlier CNMC authorisation.
The repository's earlier 9 March 2025 closing date was not officially confirmed and is not used here.

change_detection.next_review_trigger: A higher-priority source confirms the exact closing date, financing, asset list, legal vehicles, ownership, operator/manager or later capital transaction.
